1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.JunctionFan
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.JunctionGapAngles
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.GapKiteStep
4 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.NextWedgeParameters

6 /-! The actual ordered fan supplies the geometric premises of a wedge step.
7 Only the cumulative source-angle budget remains a premise for the global
8 argument. No independent arm-order or coordinate assumptions are required.
9 -/
10 
11 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.JunctionFan
12 
13 open Real Set EuclideanGeometry Wedge
14 
15 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
16   {u : T.vertices} (fan : JunctionFan T u)
17 
18 /-- Move through any chosen outgoing edge after entering along a different
19 incident edge. The angle increment is the actual metric kite's source angle. -/
20 theorem wedge_step_with_parameters
21     (incoming outgoing : circularGapMidpoints fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last)
22     (distinct : incoming ≠ outgoing) (ω : ℝ) (outer_lower : π / 2 ≤ ω)
23     (budget : ω + (fan.triangles outgoing).model.sourceAngle ≤ 3 * π / 2) :
24     let z := fan.order.chart.origin
25     let d := P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u)
26     let L := dist (u : Space) ((fan.order.neighbors outgoing).val : Space)
27     let y := z + L • direction outgoing
28     ∃ α β γ δ : ℝ,
29       IsCircularGap fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last α β ∧
30       IsCircularGap fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last γ δ ∧
31       (incoming : ℝ) = (α + β) / 2 ∧ (outgoing : ℝ) = (γ + δ) / 2 ∧
32       ∃ D Θ : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ 0 < Θ ∧ Θ < π ∧
33         D = P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget (fan.order.neighbors outgoing).val) ∧
34         π - Θ = angle (fan.triangles outgoing).model.first
35           (fan.triangles outgoing).model.right (fan.triangles outgoing).model.left ∧
36         let W := {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω α β}
37         let V := {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω δ (γ + 2 * π)}
38         let W' := {x | x - y ∈ polarRegion D (ω + (fan.triangles outgoing).model.sourceAngle)
39           (Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) (2 * π - Θ + (γ + δ) / 2)}
40         W ⊆ V ∧ Disjoint V (interior (gapKite z d L γ δ)) ∧ W' = V ∪ gapKite z d L γ δ := by
41   dsimp only
42   obtain ⟨α, β, incoming_gap, incoming_midpoint⟩ :=
43     (mem_circularGapMidpoints_iff fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last incoming).mp incoming.property
44   obtain ⟨γ, δ, outgoing_gap, outgoing_midpoint⟩ :=
45     (mem_circularGapMidpoints_iff fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last outgoing).mp outgoing.property
46   have midpoint_distinct : (α + β) / 2 ≠ (γ + δ) / 2 := by
47     intro equal
48     exact distinct (Subtype.ext (incoming_midpoint.trans (equal.trans outgoing_midpoint.symm)))
49   have separated : (β ≤ γ ∧ δ ≤ α + 2 * π) ∨ (δ ≤ α ∧ β ≤ γ + 2 * π) := by
50     rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne midpoint_distinct with before | after
51     · exact Or.inl (circular_gaps_separated fan.order.angles fan.order.increasing fan.order.bounds
52         fan.order.first fan.order.last fan.order.at_first fan.order.at_last incoming_gap outgoing_gap before)
53     · exact Or.inr (circular_gaps_separated fan.order.angles fan.order.increasing fan.order.bounds
54         fan.order.first fan.order.last fan.order.at_first fan.order.at_last outgoing_gap incoming_gap after)
55   obtain ⟨ordered, width, _, _, first_source, second_source, empty_gap⟩ := circular_gap_spec
56     fan.order.sites fan.order.angles fan.order.increasing fan.order.bounds fan.order.chart.origin
57     (P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u)) fan.order.position fan.order.first fan.order.last
58     fan.order.at_first fan.order.at_last fan.order.two outgoing_gap
59   have on_ray (ρ : ℝ) (hr : ρ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) fan.order.radius) :
60       fan.order.chart.map (fan.order.chart.origin + ρ • direction ((γ + δ) / 2)) ∈
61         openSegment ℝ (T.vertexTarget u : Space) ((fan.order.neighbors outgoing).val : Space) := by
62     rw [← outgoing_midpoint]
63     exact fan.order.rays outgoing ρ hr
64   have source_positive : 0 < P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u) := by
65     simpa using CutVoronoiChart.tail_radius_pos (T.vertexTarget_different u) (0 : unitInterval)
66       (by change (0 : ℝ) < 1; norm_num)
67   have length_positive : 0 < dist (u : Space) ((fan.order.neighbors outgoing).val : Space) := by
68     apply dist_pos.mpr
69     intro same
70     exact (fan.order.neighbors outgoing).property.ne (Subtype.ext same)
71   have angle_eq := fan.order.chart.incident_gap_source_angle T (fan.order.neighbors outgoing).property
72     rfl (fan.triangles outgoing).model ordered width first_source second_source empty_gap
73     fan.order.radius_positive on_ray
74   change angle fan.order.chart.origin
75     (fan.order.chart.origin + P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u) • direction δ)
76     (fan.order.chart.origin + dist (u : Space) ((fan.order.neighbors outgoing).val : Space) •
77       direction ((γ + δ) / 2)) = (fan.triangles outgoing).model.sourceAngle at angle_eq
78   have step := gap_rotate_and_move_with_sources fan.order.chart.origin source_positive length_positive
79     ordered width separated outer_lower (by rw [angle_eq]; exact budget)
80   dsimp only at step
81   rw [angle_eq] at step
82   obtain ⟨D, Θ, dp, tp, ts, source_position, _, step⟩ := step
83   have parameters := fan.order.chart.next_wedge_parameters T (fan.order.neighbors outgoing).property
84     rfl (fan.triangles outgoing).model ordered width first_source second_source empty_gap
85     fan.order.radius_positive on_ray dp tp ts source_position
86   refine ⟨α, β, γ, δ, incoming_gap, outgoing_gap, incoming_midpoint, outgoing_midpoint,
87     D, Θ, dp, tp, ts, parameters.1, parameters.2, ?_⟩
88   simpa only [outgoing_midpoint] using step
89 
90 
91 /-- The set-theoretic form of the step, with its identified parameters omitted. -/
92 theorem wedge_step
93     (incoming outgoing : circularGapMidpoints fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last)
94     (distinct : incoming ≠ outgoing) (ω : ℝ) (outer_lower : π / 2 ≤ ω)
95     (budget : ω + (fan.triangles outgoing).model.sourceAngle ≤ 3 * π / 2) :
96     let z := fan.order.chart.origin
97     let d := P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u)
98     let L := dist (u : Space) ((fan.order.neighbors outgoing).val : Space)
99     let y := z + L • direction outgoing
100     ∃ α β γ δ : ℝ,
101       IsCircularGap fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last α β ∧
102       IsCircularGap fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last γ δ ∧
103       (incoming : ℝ) = (α + β) / 2 ∧ (outgoing : ℝ) = (γ + δ) / 2 ∧
104       ∃ D Θ : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ 0 < Θ ∧ Θ < π ∧
105         let W := {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω α β}
106         let V := {x | x - z ∈ polarRegion d ω δ (γ + 2 * π)}
107         let W' := {x | x - y ∈ polarRegion D (ω + (fan.triangles outgoing).model.sourceAngle)
108           (Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) (2 * π - Θ + (γ + δ) / 2)}
109         W ⊆ V ∧ Disjoint V (interior (gapKite z d L γ δ)) ∧ W' = V ∪ gapKite z d L γ δ := by
110   obtain ⟨α, β, γ, δ, ig, og, im, om, D, Θ, dp, tp, ts, _, _, step⟩ :=
111     fan.wedge_step_with_parameters incoming outgoing distinct ω outer_lower budget
112   exact ⟨α, β, γ, δ, ig, og, im, om, D, Θ, dp, tp, ts, step⟩
113 
114 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.JunctionFan
